corrections.claimed_speedup: Paper abstract: mean speedup 1.74 over GCC 12.1.0 and 1.40 over Clang 15.0.6 across ten x86-64 platforms; the 1.04x over libsecp256k1's hand-optimized assembly is the verified Fiat path (Table 5: 527k vs 547k cycles; Opt 528k), under 1% over libsecp256k1's C and slower than that C on all four AMD machines (Table 7); Table 6 'Final' multiply vs the better compiler: 1.00x P-521, 1.01x Curve448, 2.26x SIKEp434
